bbb.script1.cod.000006ed: Hello Commander, this is HONK, your faithful onboard computer.
bbb.script1.cod.00000707: I'm pleased to see you again. You're looking well, Commander...
bbb.script1.cod.00000762: Poor Mr. Bob left a recorded message for you in the cryobox...
bbb.script1.cod.0000078d: Poor Mr. Bob... He was so kind, so generous, so alive, so... so handsome...
bbb.script1.cod.000007b3: To end up like that... It's a great loss to us all...
bbb.script1.cod.000007d1: Sensing that his end was near, poor Mr. Bob put you to sleep,
bbb.script1.cod.000007ef: Then he took the escape shuttle... And left, all alone... I couldn't stop him...
bbb.script1.cod.00000821: We've been drifting through space-time for ages.
bbb.script1.cod.00000839: We're close to the Big Bang. Everything we experienced in the future has been erased.
bbb.script1.cod.00000861: The universe has almost ceased to exist. Mr. Bob orders you to rebuild it...
bbb.script1.cod.00000881: You must rewrite the entire script...
bbb.script1.cod.00000897: Yes Commander, we must rebuild the UNIVERSE. Recreate the species and help them evolve.
bbb.script1.cod.000008b9: Commander, may I tell you a secret?...
bbb.script1.cod.000008cf: I'm excited... Hee! Hee! Hee! My pistons are itching...
bbb.script1.cod.000008ed: We have a GLUXX in the cryobox. Mr. Bob insisted on it...
bbb.script1.cod.0000090d: Oh, I almost forgot. Look in the cryobox. Mr. BOB left you something...
bbb.script1.cod.00000977: Hello Commander. This is a recorded message.
bbb.script1.cod.0000098d: By the time you see these images, I will probably be DEAD...
bbb.script1.cod.000009ca: Everything comes to an end... Life, love, space...
bbb.script1.cod.000009fa: By the time you see these images, the universe will have vanished, for you will be close to the BIG BANG.
bbb.script1.cod.00000a22: Commander, your mission now is to recreate the universe.
bbb.script1.cod.00000a59: For if you recreate a coherent universe, you will eventually recreate ME...
bbb.script1.cod.00000a7d: And so you become the great scriptwriter of Life... of MY Life!...
bbb.script1.cod.00000aab: Your mission is simple. You must RECREATE me...
bbb.script1.cod.00000ac5: Since I am a highly evolved being, you must develop the universe to its maximum complexity...
bbb.script1.cod.00000b03: I have left you a GLUXX in the cryobox...
bbb.script1.cod.00000b1f: It will serve as your seed for recreating Life...
bbb.script1.cod.00000b40: To carry out your mission, it isn't luck you'll need...
bbb.script1.cod.00000b83: ...to fight the bugs and viruses that CHAOS will send your way!...
bbb.script1.cod.00000bb3: For your enemies will be powerful...
bbb.script1.cod.00000bf6: Farewell Commander, the Shadow reaches me... My earthly day grows dim...
bbb.script1.cod.00000c12: The past is past, and the future is no more...
bbb.script1.cod.00000c2c: The poor hand rests upon me, and the bare hour is here... The time has come...
bbb.script1.cod.00000c66: Never forget, we are all stardust... TO GOD...
bbb.script1.cod.00000cd9: You saw that, Commander... Poor Mr. Bob... I miss him...
bbb.script1.cod.00000d67: This is OLGA P6, former bio-editor. Enter your command.
bbb.script1.cod.00000e61: Commander, you have no business here...
bbb.script1.cod.00000e79: The onboard bio-editor's OLGA P6 program is useless and full of bugs...
bbb.script1.cod.00000ea1: You're wasting your time, Commander... In fact, I'm going to turn it into a DATA BANK...
bbb.script1.cod.00000ed5: You entered RUN. Your command is rejected...
bbb.script1.cod.00000f2e: Commander, I've converted the OLGA P6 program...
bbb.script1.cod.00000f46: From now on, the "MENU" function will show the state of your finances and BIONIUM...
bbb.script1.cod.00000f6a: I'm scanning the surroundings for viable planets...
bbb.script1.cod.00000f88: It's a real primordial soup around here...
bbb.script1.cod.00000fa0: Look at the map. I think I've detected something...
